title: Mother and Child on Rural Road, 1950s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black and white snapshot from around 1950 featuring a woman with round spectacles and a mid-century tailored coat standing behind a young boy along a quiet rural road. She holds a paper package while the child enjoys a snack. The background shows bare trees on a hillside and telephone poles along the pavement, capturing everyday life in mid-20th-century America. The print has distinct scalloped deckle edges.
